from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess
r=Path.cwd();h=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();s=json.loads((r/'.runtime/preservation.json').read_text());raw=r/'wiki-project/raw'
for p,v in {**s['nonWikiSha256'],**s['oldRawSha256']}.items():assert h((r/p).read_bytes())==v,p
assert h((r/'wiki-project/log.md').read_bytes()[:s['logPrefixBytes']])==s['logPrefixSha256']
for name in ['C集成-迁移方案执行与联合验收','C集成候选-依赖与非作者签认','C04-收口签认']:assert 'status: active' in (r/'wiki-project/wiki/tasks'/(name+'.md')).read_text()
a=json.loads((raw/'c-a-lineage-fourth-intake.json').read_text());n=json.loads((raw/'c-a-lineage-fourth-native.json').read_text());m=json.loads((raw/'c-a-lineage-fourth-m13.json').read_text());x=json.loads((raw/'c-a-lineage-fourth-m13-extra.json').read_text());b=json.loads((raw/'c-b-third-feedback-intake.json').read_text())
assert a['ACommit']=='cece332e41a230ebbeeaee64eb283b49a5d4fb43' and a['sourceAuditSummary']=={'nonWikiFiles':175,'allMatchFixedGitBlob':True}
assert n['summary']['passed']==12 and m['summary']=={'total':9,'passed':9,'failed':[]} and x['summary']=={'total':2,'passed':0,'failed':['M13-X10','M13-X11']}
for c in m['originalFour']['cases']+m['previousFiveVariants']['cases']:assert c['expectationMet'] and c['control']['guardRejectedOperation'] and c['migrationError'] and c['identifyError'] and c['before']==c['after']
for c in x['cases']:assert c['control']['guardRejectedOperation'] and c['identifyError'] is None and c['migrationError'] is None and c['behaviorError'] is None and c['after']['version']==8 and not c['expectationMet']
assert x['cases'][0]['behavior']['deleted'] and x['cases'][1]['behavior']['sameAttemptPreparedRows']==2
for key,cmd in a['actualCommands'].items():
 assert cmd['exitCode']==(1 if key=='M13Extra' else 0),key
 for k in ['stdout','stderr','output']:
  if k in cmd:assert h(cmd[k].encode())==cmd[k+'Sha256'],key
assert '45 passed (45)' in a['actualCommands']['infrastructure']['stdout'] and '35 passed (35)' in a['actualCommands']['contracts']['stdout']
assert a['sqlFingerprintsMatchPriorFixedCAndB'] and a['authorProbeComparison']['structuredResultsMatchFixedAuthorRecord']
assert b['fixedCommit']=='b80ad4329e7a72f4990aea89eced0536d6ebba1d' and b['status']=='fixed_material_review_passed' and b['rawEvidenceReadable'] and b['authorWikiReadable']
assert all(b['provenance'].values()) and b['sourceScope']['sourceDiffOutsideWiki']==[] and all(x['unchangedAtRemoteHead'] for x in b['sourceScope']['testFiles'])
assert len(b['sourceScope']['testFiles'])==8 and all(not b['boundaries'][k] for k in ['newCompositionTested','macOSDesktopTested','humanSignoffProvided','merged','automaticMessagesSent','realModelRetested'])
for c in b['verifiedBChecks']:
 assert c['exit_code']==0
 for k in ['stdout','stderr']:assert h(c[k].encode())==c[k+'Sha256']
c=b['CIndependentHelperReplay'];assert c['exitCode']==0 and len(json.loads(c['stdout'])['cases'])==3
for k in ['stdout','stderr']:assert h(c[k].encode())==c[k+'Sha256']
for f in b['fixedFiles']:assert h(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',b['fixedCommit']+':'+f['path']]))==f['sha256']
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','codex/c-a-lineage-third-validation']).decode().strip()=='a633c4285f240e7ab4f8d3fa554efeed802e44e8'
assert 'X10/X11失败' in (r/'wiki-project/wiki/C迁移联合验证用例.md').read_text()
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','nonWikiPreserved':len(s['nonWikiSha256']),'oldRawPreserved':len(s['oldRawSha256']),'logPrefixBytes':s['logPrefixBytes'],'requestedNinePassed':True,'extraTwoFailuresPreserved':True,'BFixedWikiEvidenceVerified':True,'B100RemainsWindowsEvidence':True,'CHelper3Passed':True,'humanTasksActive':True,'priorCBranchUnchanged':True}))
